manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.lead: We believe the internet lost its way when people became products.
manifesto.p1: For two decades, platforms have harvested behavior, predicted desire, and quietly shaped choices. Convenience became the trade. Freedom became the cost.
manifesto.emphasis1: We reject the idea that connection must require surveillance.
manifesto.p2: LoveLace exists because identity should belong to the individual, not the platform. Data should be controlled, not extracted. Relationships should be voluntary, not engineered by opaque algorithms.
manifesto.p3: We stand on a simple principle:
manifesto.principle1: Cryptography replaces trust where trust is abused.
manifesto.principle2: In a world of behavioral profiling, we choose consent.
manifesto.principle3: In a world of algorithmic manipulation, we choose transparency.
manifesto.principle4: In a world of digital feudalism, we choose sovereignty.
manifesto.p4: We are not building another social network designed to maximize engagement loops. We are building infrastructure for human choice.
manifesto.decl4: And value flows to the participants, not to intermediaries.
manifesto.p5: The future of social technology will not be defined by who controls the largest dataset. It will be defined by who gives control back to people.
manifesto.p6: We build for the ones who believe privacy is normal. That autonomy is non-negotiable. And that technology should expand freedom, not quietly erode it.
manifesto.closing_sub: The social layer is being rewritten.

bot_strategies.always_guarantee_p: Posada evaluates exit signals on every open position, every cycle, unconditionally. This is a core safety principle: a bot that can buy but can't sell is useless.
bot_strategies.always_means_1: If you disable a strategy, positions opened by that strategy are still actively managed — the bot continues to evaluate take-profit, stop-loss, and all other exit conditions using the original strategy's logic
bot_strategies.always_means_2: If all your funds are invested and the USDM balance is zero, sell signals still fire normally
bot_strategies.always_means_3: If you switch from one strategy to another, old positions from the previous strategy are not orphaned — they keep being evaluated until they exit
bot_strategies.always_means_4: Each position uses the parameters you configured for its strategy — an LWMR position uses your LWMR take-profit and stop-loss settings, a CPR position uses your CPR settings
bot_strategies.always_oneliner: Positions are always managed — no matter what.
bot_strategies.always_technical_p: The exit engine runs as a separate evaluation pass before the entry/strategy routing. It scans all open positions, looks up which strategy opened each one, loads your configured parameters for that strategy, and calls that strategy's signal function. If the signal says SELL or SELL_HALF, the trade executes immediately. This happens regardless of which strategies are currently enabled in the dashboard.
bot_strategies.auto_oneliner: All six run simultaneously — the best signal wins.
bot_strategies.auto_position_p: Each position remembers which strategy opened it. Only that strategy manages the exit — take-profit, stop-loss, ADD, and SELL_HALF signals all come from the same strategy that entered. This prevents conflicting signals from different strategies fighting over the same position.
bot_strategies.auto_process_p: Every poll cycle (default 60 seconds), Posada evaluates all enabled strategies against each watched token. The strategies are checked in priority order: LWMR, BWR, VBR, LRM, RRA, CPR. The first strategy to produce a BUY signal for a given token wins.
bot_strategies.auto_safety_1: Maximum percentage per trade (default 25% of wallet)
bot_strategies.auto_safety_2: Maximum trades per hour (default 10) and per day (default 50)
bot_strategies.auto_safety_3: Daily drawdown protection — buys pause if the wallet drops more than 15% in a day
bot_strategies.auto_safety_4: Price divergence check — rejects trades if price moved more than 8% between signal and execution
bot_strategies.auto_safety_5: Minimum pool liquidity check — skips tokens with thin orderbooks
bot_strategies.auto_safety_6: Cooldown between trades on the same token (default 10 minutes)
bot_strategies.bwr_best_p: Trending markets with strong momentum Works on tokens making new highs — NIGHT during rally phases, SNEK during hype cycles, or any token breaking out of a consolidation range.
bot_strategies.bwr_entry_1: Recent high breaks above the resistance level from the last 25 candles (by at least 0.5%)
bot_strategies.bwr_entry_2: Current price has pulled back from the high (retest) but stays above resistance
bot_strategies.bwr_entry_3: All three conditions must be true simultaneously
bot_strategies.bwr_exit_1: SELL Price falls 3% below the breakout level — breakout failed
bot_strategies.bwr_exit_2: SELL Take-profit or stop-loss hit
bot_strategies.bwr_how_p: BWR looks at the last 30 price candles to identify resistance levels. When price breaks above resistance and then pulls back slightly (the "retest"), it buys — confirming the breakout is real, not a fakeout. This is a classic technical analysis pattern used by professional traders.
bot_strategies.bwr_mgmt_1: ADD If price climbs 2% above entry, the bot adds once — momentum confirmed
bot_strategies.bwr_oneliner: Catch the breakout, ride the trend.
bot_strategies.cpr_best_p: Bear and falling markets The only strategy designed to profit when most tokens are trending down. Targets sharp, panicked sell-offs that often produce a relief bounce. Most effective on tokens with enough volume to produce genuine capitulation events — SNEK, NIGHT, WMTX during broad market corrections.
bot_strategies.cpr_entry_1: Price below the 2.5-sigma Bollinger Band (extreme statistical oversold — well beyond the normal 2-sigma)
bot_strategies.cpr_entry_2: RSI(14) below 30 (deeply oversold — panic selling detected)
bot_strategies.cpr_entry_3: 3-period momentum is positive (the bounce has started — avoids catching falling knives)
bot_strategies.cpr_entry_4: Price has dropped more than 4% from the 20-period high (confirms a real dip, not just noise)
bot_strategies.cpr_entry_title: Entry signal — ALL four must align
bot_strategies.cpr_exit_1: SELL Take-profit at 10% — clears the 3% friction with ~7% net profit
bot_strategies.cpr_exit_2: SELL Stop-loss at 8% — limits damage to ~11% net loss after friction
bot_strategies.cpr_exit_3: SELL 5-period momentum drops below -3% — the bounce has failed
bot_strategies.cpr_exit_4: SELL RSI exceeds 65 — overbought, the bounce is exhausted
bot_strategies.cpr_how_p: CPR is designed specifically for falling and bear markets, where the other strategies tend to lose money. Cardano DEXs have roughly 3% round-trip friction (1% buy slippage + 2% sell slippage), so CPR only enters at extreme oversold levels where the expected bounce is large enough to clear that cost. It requires four independent confirmations before buying — this makes it trade rarely, but with higher conviction.
bot_strategies.cpr_mgmt_1: No adds — CPR never averages down into capitulation events. One entry, one exit.
bot_strategies.cpr_mgmt_2: The strategy trades infrequently by design. It may go days without a signal, waiting for genuine capitulation events.
bot_strategies.cpr_mgmt_3: Needs roughly 61% win rate to break even given the asymmetric TP/SL after friction costs.
bot_strategies.cpr_oneliner: Catch extreme oversold bounces in bear markets.
bot_strategies.lrm_best_p: Clearly trending markets The go-to strategy when a token is on a sustained run. Works on tokens with strong catalysts — project announcements, exchange listings, or market-wide rallies. Most active of all five strategies.
bot_strategies.lrm_entry_2: Both timeframes must agree — this filters out noise and catches genuine moves
bot_strategies.lrm_exit_1: SELL 5-period momentum drops below -1% — the trend has reversed
bot_strategies.lrm_exit_2: SELL Take-profit or stop-loss hit
bot_strategies.lrm_how_p: LRM is a pure momentum strategy. It measures how much a token's price has moved over the last 3 and 5 candles. When both short-term and medium-term momentum are positive and strong enough, it buys — riding the wave of buying pressure. When momentum reverses, it exits quickly.
bot_strategies.lrm_mgmt_1: ADD If momentum exceeds +2%, the bot adds to the position (up to 2 adds)
bot_strategies.lrm_mgmt_2: This is the most aggressive strategy for riding strong moves
bot_strategies.lrm_mgmt_3: Fast entry and exit — trades can last minutes to hours
bot_strategies.lrm_oneliner: Follow the momentum, exit when it fades.
bot_strategies.lwmr_best_p: Calm, low-volatility markets Works best on tokens that trade in a predictable range. Steady grinders like MIN, INDY, or stablecoin-adjacent pairs.
bot_strategies.lwmr_entry_1: Price falls below the mean by more than the dynamic threshold
bot_strategies.lwmr_entry_2: Threshold adapts to volatility — wider bands in choppy markets, tighter in calm ones
bot_strategies.lwmr_exit_1: SELL Price reverts back to the mean — profit taken
bot_strategies.lwmr_how_p: LWMR calculates a 20-period moving average and standard deviation of recent prices. When the price drops significantly below the mean (at least 1 standard deviation or 2%, whichever is greater), it triggers a buy — the idea being that prices tend to revert back to their average.
bot_strategies.lwmr_mgmt_1: ADD If price drops 1.5x deeper than entry threshold, the bot adds to the position (up to 2 adds)
bot_strategies.lwmr_oneliner: Buy the dip, sell the recovery.
bot_strategies.rra_best_p: Portfolio rotation across multiple tokens Excels when different tokens take turns leading the market. Rather than picking one winner, RRA systematically rotates into whichever token has the strongest relative momentum.
bot_strategies.rra_entry_2: Score = 50% weight on 3-period momentum + 30% weight on 10-period momentum
bot_strategies.rra_entry_3: Short-term momentum must also be positive (no fading entries)
bot_strategies.rra_exit_1: SELL Rotation score drops below -0.75 — relative strength has faded
bot_strategies.rra_exit_2: SELL 5-period momentum drops below -2% — outright reversal
bot_strategies.rra_exit_3: SELL Take-profit or stop-loss hit
bot_strategies.rra_how_p: RRA doesn't just look at whether a token is going up — it asks whether it's going up faster than the rest of the market. It calculates a rotation score by weighting short-term (3-period) and long-term (10-period) momentum. Tokens with high relative strength get bought; those losing strength get sold.
bot_strategies.rra_mgmt_1: No adds — RRA relies on picking the right token at the right time rather than averaging in
bot_strategies.rra_mgmt_2: Designed to work across the full token watchlist, comparing relative performance
bot_strategies.rra_oneliner: Rotate into tokens outperforming the market.
bot_strategies.subtitle: Posada runs six autonomous strategies simultaneously. Each one watches price history and generates signals — BUY, SELL, ADD, or SELL_HALF. The bot picks the best strategy for each token based on current market conditions. Exit signals are evaluated every cycle regardless of which strategies are toggled on or off — positions are always managed.
bot_strategies.title: Trading Strategies Explained
bot_strategies.vbr_best_p: Volatile, choppy markets Thrives when tokens are swinging wildly — HOSKY during meme cycles, or any token with large daily swings. The wider the bands, the bigger the opportunity.
bot_strategies.vbr_entry_1: Price drops below the lower Bollinger Band
bot_strategies.vbr_entry_2: This means the token has moved more than 2 standard deviations from its recent average — an extreme move that often reverses
bot_strategies.vbr_exit_1: SELL_HALF Price reaches the middle band — lock in partial profit
bot_strategies.vbr_exit_2: SELL Price reaches the upper band — full exit at the other extreme
bot_strategies.vbr_exit_3: SELL Take-profit or stop-loss hit
bot_strategies.vbr_how_p: VBR uses Bollinger Bands — a channel drawn 2 standard deviations above and below a 20-period moving average. When price drops below the lower band, it's statistically oversold. The bot buys and waits for price to snap back toward the middle or upper band.
bot_strategies.vbr_mgmt_1: SELL_HALF is unique to VBR — it sells 50% at the midline, letting the rest ride to the upper band
bot_strategies.vbr_mgmt_2: ADD If price drops below the lower band again after entry, the bot adds up to 3 times
bot_strategies.vbr_mgmt_3: This aggressive adding works because extreme band violations have high mean-reversion probability
bot_strategies.vbr_oneliner: Trade the extremes using Bollinger Bands.
